messages:
Anika (Partnerships): Heads-up: BlueRidge SI requested our SOC2 pdf, pen-test executive summary, and a marketplace evidence bundle. Need to align on redaction and delivery date.
Vikram (InfoSec): We can share SOC2 type II and the pen-test exec summary. For the bundle, we should only include sanitized vuln output and a manifest. No raw exploit appendices.
Hana (Partner Eng): Marketplace ingestion asks for manifest.json, artifacts.csv, and a single tar.gz. They prefer SHA256 checksums and presigned links with TTL. BlueRidge asked for 5-day access.
Claire (Legal): Legal notes: redact customer names, IP ranges, and contractual excerpts. Do not share full vendor pen-test appendices unless there's an NDA or MSA addendum. Use attestation language: "Artifacts provided contain no customer-identifiable information."
Vikram (InfoSec): Proposed scrub steps: run scanner -> export CSV summary (cve,severity,component,status) -> run redact script to remove hostnames/emails -> generate sha256 manifest. I can own the script and publish the scrub log hash.
Build Bot: artifact-job #998 created evidence-1751239999.tar.gz and manifest.json :white_check_mark:
Anika (Partnerships): Action items: Vikram to scrub + upload (owner), Claire to sign attestation (owner), Hana to request presigns (owner). Target: 2024-10-02 EOD to meet BlueRidge listing.
Hana (Partner Eng): I'll ask BlueRidge to confirm they accept 5-day presign and whether they need firmware checksums separately.
Claire (Legal): Drafting attestation now, will post for quick review.
Vikram (InfoSec): I'll post scrubbed CSV and manifest hash tomorrow morning.
Anika (Partnerships): Thanks team — reconvene Wednesday 09:00 PT to confirm. :thumbsup:
